actions.action: Check soil moisture with a finger before watering
Water thoroughly when the top 2-3 inches are dry and let it drain
Check that the pot drains freely and roots are firm and white
Move plant to the brightest spot without direct sun
Trim fully dead leaves at the base with clean scissors
